WIDTH = screen.WIDTH
DEPTH = screen.DEPTH
LATE_START = screen.LATE_START
ALPHA_DEAD = fnp.float32(screen.ALPHA_DEAD)
EXACT_ZERO_PILOT_GAP = 48
COLD_ACTIVE_MAX = 176
PILOT_ROWS = 1_652


def pilot_classification(
    first_activations: fnp.ndarray,
    weights: Sequence[fnp.ndarray],
    recurrence: list[dict[str, fnp.ndarray]],
) -> tuple[list[fnp.ndarray], fnp.ndarray, list[int]]:
    pilot = fnp.reshape(first_activations, (-1, WIDTH))[:PILOT_ROWS]
    masks = [fnp.arange(WIDTH, dtype=fnp.int64)]
    pilot_live_widths = [
        int(
            fnp.nonzero(
                fnp.any(
                    pilot > fnp.float32(0.0),
                    axis=0,
                )
            )[0].shape[0]
        )
    ]
    for weight_index, weight in enumerate(weights[1:LATE_START], start=1):
        pre = fnp.matmul(pilot, weight)
        rows = fnp.reshape(pre, (-1, WIDTH))
        dead = fnp.logical_and(
            recurrence[weight_index]["alpha"] < ALPHA_DEAD,
            fnp.all(rows <= fnp.float32(0.0), axis=0),
        )
        masks.append(fnp.nonzero(fnp.logical_not(dead))[0])
        pilot = fnp.maximum(pre, fnp.float32(0.0))
        active_pilot = pilot[:, masks[-1]]
        pilot_live_widths.append(
            int(
                fnp.nonzero(
                    fnp.any(
                        fnp.reshape(
                            active_pilot,
                            (-1, active_pilot.shape[-1]),
                        )
                        > fnp.float32(0.0),
                        axis=0,
                    )
                )[0].shape[0]
            )
        )
    return masks, pilot, pilot_live_widths


def select_route(
    active_input_width: int,
    active_output_width: int,
    pilot_live_input_width: int,
) -> str:
    if active_input_width == WIDTH and active_output_width == WIDTH:
        return "chunked_e136"
    if pilot_live_input_width <= active_input_width - EXACT_ZERO_PILOT_GAP:
        return "exact_zero_after_dead"
    if active_input_width <= COLD_ACTIVE_MAX and active_output_width <= COLD_ACTIVE_MAX:
        return "dead_cold"
    return "analytic_dead_dense"


def compact_prefix(
    first_activations: fnp.ndarray,
    weights: Sequence[fnp.ndarray],
    recurrence: list[dict[str, fnp.ndarray]],
    masks: list[fnp.ndarray],
    pilot_live_widths: list[int],
) -> tuple[fnp.ndarray, list[dict[str, int]]]:
    active_ids = masks[0]
    activations = first_activations[:, :, active_ids]
    layers = []
    for layer, weight in enumerate(weights[1:LATE_START], start=2):

        selected_weight = weight[active_ids, :]
        local_ids = fnp.arange(activations.shape[-1], dtype=fnp.int64)
        route = select_route(
            int(active_ids.shape[0]),
            int(output_ids.shape[0]),
            pilot_live_widths[layer - 2],
        )
        local_output_ids = fnp.arange(output_ids.shape[0], dtype=fnp.int64)
        active_weight = selected_weight[:, output_ids]
        bias = None
        if active_ids.shape[0] < WIDTH:
            previous_mean = recurrence[layer - 2]["mean"]
            full_mean = fnp.matmul(
                previous_mean[None, :],
                weight[:, output_ids],
            )[0]
            active_mean = fnp.matmul(
                previous_mean[active_ids][None, :],
                active_weight,
            )[0]
            bias = full_mean - active_mean
        if route == "exact_zero_after_dead":
            activations, info = screen.exact_zero_relu(
                activations,
                active_weight,
                bias,
            )
        elif route == "dead_cold":
            activations, info = screen.cold_packed_relu(
                activations,
                active_weight,
                local_ids,
                local_output_ids,
                bias,
            )
        else:
            activations, info = screen.dense_compacted_relu(
                activations,
                active_weight,
                local_ids,
                local_output_ids,
                bias,
            )
        layers.append(
            {
                "layer": layer,
                "route": route,
                "active_input_width": int(active_ids.shape[0]),
                "active_output_width": int(output_ids.shape[0]),
                "pilot_live_input_width": pilot_live_widths[layer - 2],
                "padded_input_width": int(
                    info.get(
                        "padded_input_width",
                        info.get("active_input_width", active_ids.shape[0]),
                    )
                ),
                "padded_output_width": int(
                    info.get(
                        "padded_output_width",
                        output_ids.shape[0],
                    )
                ),
            }
        )
        active_ids = output_ids
    return activations, layers


def compact_late_fold(
    a29: fnp.ndarray,
    active29: fnp.ndarray,
    w30: fnp.ndarray,
    w31: fnp.ndarray,
    w32: fnp.ndarray,
    analytic_mean29: fnp.ndarray,
    analytic_mean30: fnp.ndarray,
    analytic_mean31: fnp.ndarray,
    analytic_mean32: fnp.ndarray,
    alpha30: fnp.ndarray,
    alpha31: fnp.ndarray,
    alpha32: fnp.ndarray,
    pilot_z30: fnp.ndarray,
    pilot_z31: fnp.ndarray,
    pilot_z32: fnp.ndarray,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    p30 = e136._partition(alpha30, pilot_z30)
    p31 = e136._partition(alpha31, pilot_z31)
    p32 = e136._partition(alpha32, pilot_z32)
    d30, o30, k30 = p30["dead"], p30["on"], p30["kink"]
    d31, o31, k31 = p31["dead"], p31["on"], p31["kink"]
    d32, o32, k32 = p32["dead"], p32["on"], p32["kink"]
    w30_active = w30[active29, :]
    mean_a29 = e136._mean_rows(a29, active29.shape[0])
    full_mean30 = e136._matmul_or_zero(analytic_mean29[None, :], w30)[0]
    active_mean30 = e136._matmul_or_zero(
        analytic_mean29[active29][None, :],
        w30_active,
    )[0]
    dead_bias30 = full_mean30 - active_mean30

    z30_k = e136._matmul_or_zero(a29, w30_active[:, k30]) + dead_bias30[k30]
    a30_k = fnp.maximum(z30_k, fnp.float32(0.0))
    mean_k30 = (
        e136._mean_rows(a30_k, k30.shape[0]) if k30.shape[0] else fnp.zeros(0, dtype=a29.dtype)
    )
    mean_o30 = e136._matmul_or_zero(mean_a29[None, :], w30_active[:, o30])[0] + dead_bias30[o30]

    z31_k = (
        e136._matmul_or_zero(a30_k, e136._block(w31, k30, k31))
        + e136._matmul_or_zero(
            a29,
            e136._matmul_or_zero(
                w30_active[:, o30],
                e136._block(w31, o30, k31),
            ),
        )
        + e136._matmul_or_zero(
            dead_bias30[o30][None, :],
            e136._block(w31, o30, k31),
        )
        + e136._matmul_or_zero(
            analytic_mean30[d30][None, :],
            e136._block(w31, d30, k31),
        )
    )
    a31_k = fnp.maximum(z31_k, fnp.float32(0.0))
    mean_k31 = (
        e136._mean_rows(a31_k, k31.shape[0]) if k31.shape[0] else fnp.zeros(0, dtype=a29.dtype)
    )
    mean_o31 = (
        e136._matmul_or_zero(
            analytic_mean30[d30][None, :],
            e136._block(w31, d30, o31),
        )[0]
        + e136._matmul_or_zero(
            mean_o30[None, :],
            e136._block(w31, o30, o31),
        )[0]
        + e136._matmul_or_zero(
            mean_k30[None, :],
            e136._block(w31, k30, o31),
        )[0]
    )
    z31_o = (
        e136._matmul_or_zero(a30_k, e136._block(w31, k30, o31))
        + e136._matmul_or_zero(
            a29,
            e136._matmul_or_zero(
                w30_active[:, o30],
                e136._block(w31, o30, o31),
            ),
        )
        + e136._matmul_or_zero(
            dead_bias30[o30][None, :],
            e136._block(w31, o30, o31),
        )
        + e136._matmul_or_zero(
            analytic_mean30[d30][None, :],
            e136._block(w31, d30, o31),
        )
    )

    z32_k = (
        e136._matmul_or_zero(a31_k, e136._block(w32, k31, k32))
        + e136._matmul_or_zero(z31_o, e136._block(w32, o31, k32))
        + e136._matmul_or_zero(
            analytic_mean31[d31][None, :],
            e136._block(w32, d31, k32),
        )
    )
    mean_k32 = (
        e136._mean_rows(
            fnp.maximum(z32_k, fnp.float32(0.0)),
            k32.shape[0],
        )
        if k32.shape[0]
        else fnp.zeros(0, dtype=a29.dtype)
    )
    mean_o32 = (
        e136._matmul_or_zero(
            analytic_mean31[d31][None, :],
            e136._block(w32, d31, o32),
        )[0]
        + e136._matmul_or_zero(
            mean_o31[None, :],
            e136._block(w32, o31, o32),
        )[0]
        + e136._matmul_or_zero(
            mean_k31[None, :],
            e136._block(w32, k31, o32),
        )[0]
    )
    final_mean = (
        e136._map_subset(analytic_mean32[d32], d32, WIDTH)
        + e136._map_subset(mean_o32, o32, WIDTH)
        + e136._map_subset(mean_k32, k32, WIDTH)
    )
    return {
        "final_mean": final_mean,
        "class_counts": {
            "layer30": {name: int(ids.shape[0]) for name, ids in p30.items()},
            "layer31": {name: int(ids.shape[0]) for name, ids in p31.items()},
            "layer32": {name: int(ids.shape[0]) for name, ids in p32.items()},

    }


def predict_with_diagnostics(
    weights: Sequence[fnp.ndarray],
    codes: fnp.ndarray,
    coordinate_signs: fnp.ndarray,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    recurrence = e136.diagonal_gaussian_recurrence(weights)
    first = e136.antipodal_kerdock_activations(

def predict_from_masks(
    weights: Sequence[fnp.ndarray],
    recurrence: list[dict[str, fnp.ndarray]],
    first: fnp.ndarray,
    pilot_a29: fnp.ndarray,
    masks: list[fnp.ndarray],
    pilot_live_widths: list[int],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    a29, layers = compact_prefix(

        fnp.maximum(pilot_z30, fnp.float32(0.0)),
        weights[30],

        fnp.maximum(pilot_z31, fnp.float32(0.0)),
        weights[31],
    )
    folded = compact_late_fold(
        a29,
        masks[-1],
        weights[29],
        weights[30],
        weights[31],
        recurrence[28]["mean"],
        recurrence[29]["mean"],
        recurrence[30]["mean"],
        recurrence[31]["mean"],
        recurrence[29]["alpha"],
        recurrence[30]["alpha"],
        recurrence[31]["alpha"],
        pilot_z30,
        pilot_z31,
        pilot_z32,
    )
    folded["prefix_layers"] = layers
    folded["active_widths"] = [int(mask.shape[0]) for mask in masks]
    folded["pilot_live_widths"] = pilot_live_widths
    folded["masks"] = masks
    folded["prediction"] = fnp.concatenate(
        (
            fnp.zeros((DEPTH - 1, WIDTH), dtype=fnp.float32),
            folded["final_mean"][None, :],
        ),
        axis=0,
    )
    return folded

def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:

def array_hash(value: Any) -> str:
    array = np.ascontiguousarray(np.asarray(value))
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    digest.update(str(array.dtype).encode())
    digest.update(np.asarray(array.shape, dtype=np.int64).tobytes())

    return digest.hexdigest()

        "reserved_result_absent": not reserved.exists(),
    }


def measure(screen: Any, context: flops.BudgetContext) -> dict[str, Any]:
    summary = screen.measure(context)
    return {
        "flops_used": int(summary["flops_used"]),
        "effective_compute": float(summary["effective_compute"]),
        "wall_time_s": float(summary["wall_time_s"]),
        "residual_wall_time_s": float(summary["residual_wall_time_s"]),
        "operations": summary["operations"],
        "operations_reconcile": bool(summary["operations_reconcile"]),
    }


def multiplier_reconciliation(effective_compute: float) -> dict[str, float | bool]:
    official = float(score_multiplier(effective_compute, float(FLOP_BUDGET), failed=False))
    manual = max(0.1, effective_compute / float(FLOP_BUDGET))
    return {"official": official, "manual": manual, "reconciles": official == manual}


def _array_bytes(value: fnp.ndarray) -> int:
    return math.prod(value.shape) * np.dtype(value.dtype).itemsize


def _track(ledger: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], name: str, value: fnp.ndarray) -> fnp.ndarray:
    ledger[name] = {"shape": list(value.shape), "bytes": _array_bytes(value)}
    return value


def _compact_late_fold_and_residuals(
    e141: Any,
    a29: fnp.ndarray,
    active29: fnp.ndarray,
    w30: fnp.ndarray,
    w31: fnp.ndarray,
    w32: fnp.ndarray,
    analytic_mean29: fnp.ndarray,
    analytic_mean30: fnp.ndarray,
    analytic_mean31: fnp.ndarray,
    analytic_mean32: fnp.ndarray,
    alpha30: fnp.ndarray,
    alpha31: fnp.ndarray,
    alpha32: fnp.ndarray,
    pilot_z30: fnp.ndarray,
    pilot_z31: fnp.ndarray,
    pilot_z32: fnp.ndarray,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    p30 = e141._partition(alpha30, pilot_z30)
    p31 = e141._partition(alpha31, pilot_z31)
    p32 = e141._partition(alpha32, pilot_z32)
    d30, o30, k30 = p30["dead"], p30["on"], p30["kink"]
    d31, o31, k31 = p31["dead"], p31["on"], p31["kink"]
    d32, o32, k32 = p32["dead"], p32["on"], p32["kink"]
    w30_active = w30[active29, :]
    mean_a29 = e141._mean_rows(a29, active29.shape[0])
    full_mean30 = e141._matmul_or_zero(analytic_mean29[None, :], w30)[0]
    active_mean30 = e141._matmul_or_zero(analytic_mean29[active29][None, :], w30_active)[0]
    dead_bias30 = full_mean30 - active_mean30

    z30_k = e141._matmul_or_zero(a29, w30_active[:, k30]) + dead_bias30[k30]
    a30_k = fnp.maximum(z30_k, fnp.float32(0.0))
    mean_k30 = (
        e141._mean_rows(a30_k, k30.shape[0]) if k30.shape[0] else fnp.zeros(0, dtype=a29.dtype)
    )
    mean_o30 = (
        e141._matmul_or_zero(
            mean_a29[None, :],
            w30_active[:, o30],
        )[0]
        + dead_bias30[o30]
    )
    z31_k = (
        e141._matmul_or_zero(a30_k, e141._block(w31, k30, k31))
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(
            a29,
            e141._matmul_or_zero(w30_active[:, o30], e141._block(w31, o30, k31)),
        )
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(dead_bias30[o30][None, :], e141._block(w31, o30, k31))
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(analytic_mean30[d30][None, :], e141._block(w31, d30, k31))
    )
    a31_k = fnp.maximum(z31_k, fnp.float32(0.0))
    mean_k31 = (
        e141._mean_rows(a31_k, k31.shape[0]) if k31.shape[0] else fnp.zeros(0, dtype=a29.dtype)
    )
    mean_o31 = (
        e141._matmul_or_zero(
            analytic_mean30[d30][None, :],
            e141._block(w31, d30, o31),
        )[0]
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(
            mean_o30[None, :],
            e141._block(w31, o30, o31),
        )[0]
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(
            mean_k30[None, :],
            e141._block(w31, k30, o31),
        )[0]
    )
    z31_o = (
        e141._matmul_or_zero(a30_k, e141._block(w31, k30, o31))
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(
            a29,
            e141._matmul_or_zero(w30_active[:, o30], e141._block(w31, o30, o31)),
        )
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(dead_bias30[o30][None, :], e141._block(w31, o30, o31))
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(analytic_mean30[d30][None, :], e141._block(w31, d30, o31))
    )
    z32_k = (
        e141._matmul_or_zero(a31_k, e141._block(w32, k31, k32))
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(z31_o, e141._block(w32, o31, k32))
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(analytic_mean31[d31][None, :], e141._block(w32, d31, k32))
    )
    mean_k32 = (
        e141._mean_rows(fnp.maximum(z32_k, fnp.float32(0.0)), k32.shape[0])
        if k32.shape[0]
        else fnp.zeros(0, dtype=a29.dtype)
    )
    mean_o32 = (
        e141._matmul_or_zero(
            analytic_mean31[d31][None, :],
            e141._block(w32, d31, o32),
        )[0]
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(
            mean_o31[None, :],
            e141._block(w32, o31, o32),
        )[0]
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(
            mean_k31[None, :],
            e141._block(w32, k31, o32),
        )[0]
    )
    final_mean = (
        e141._map_subset(analytic_mean32[d32], d32, WIDTH)
        + e141._map_subset(mean_o32, o32, WIDTH)
        + e141._map_subset(mean_k32, k32, WIDTH)
    )
    ledger: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    r30 = _track(
        ledger,
        "r30",
        e141._map_subset(mean_k30 - analytic_mean30[k30], k30, WIDTH),
    )
    r31 = _track(
        ledger,
        "r31",
        e141._map_subset(mean_k31 - analytic_mean31[k31], k31, WIDTH),
    )
    r32 = _track(
        ledger,
        "r32",
        e141._map_subset(mean_k32 - analytic_mean32[k32], k32, WIDTH),
    )
    g31 = _track(
        ledger,
        "g31",
        fnp.asarray(flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha31), dtype=fnp.float32),
    )
    g32 = _track(
        ledger,
        "g32",
        fnp.asarray(flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha32), dtype=fnp.float32),
    )
    t30 = _track(
        ledger,
        "t30",
        fnp.multiply(
            fnp.matmul(
                fnp.multiply(fnp.matmul(r30, w31), g31),
                w32,
            ),
            g32,
        ),
    )
    t31 = _track(ledger, "t31", fnp.multiply(fnp.matmul(r31, w32), g32))
    features = _track(ledger, "features", fnp.stack((t30, t31, r32), axis=0))
    return {
        "final_mean": final_mean,
        "features": features,
        "class_counts": {
            "layer30": {name: int(ids.shape[0]) for name, ids in p30.items()},
            "layer31": {name: int(ids.shape[0]) for name, ids in p31.items()},
            "layer32": {name: int(ids.shape[0]) for name, ids in p32.items()},
        },
        "array_ledger": ledger,
    }


def e157_prediction(
    weights: Sequence[fnp.ndarray],
    codes: fnp.ndarray,
    signs: fnp.ndarray,
    beta: np.ndarray | Sequence[float],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    e141, _, _ = dependencies()
    if len(weights) != DEPTH or weights[0].shape != (WIDTH, WIDTH):
        raise ValueError("e157 requires a 32-layer width-256 MLP")
    coefficients = fnp.asarray(np.asarray(beta, dtype=np.float32), dtype=fnp.float32)
    if coefficients.shape != (3,):
        raise ValueError("e157 requires exactly three shared scalar coefficients")
    recurrence = e141.diagonal_gaussian_recurrence(weights)
    first = e141.antipodal_kerdock_activations(weights[0], codes, signs)
    masks, pilot_a29, pilot_live_widths = e141.pilot_classification(first, weights, recurrence)
    a29, layers = e141.compact_prefix(first, weights, recurrence, masks, pilot_live_widths)
    pilot_z30 = fnp.matmul(pilot_a29, weights[29])
    pilot_z31 = fnp.matmul(fnp.maximum(pilot_z30, fnp.float32(0.0)), weights[30])
    pilot_z32 = fnp.matmul(fnp.maximum(pilot_z31, fnp.float32(0.0)), weights[31])
    folded = _compact_late_fold_and_residuals(
        e141,
        a29,
        masks[-1],
        weights[29],
        weights[30],
        weights[31],
        recurrence[28]["mean"],
        recurrence[29]["mean"],
        recurrence[30]["mean"],
        recurrence[31]["mean"],
        recurrence[29]["alpha"],
        recurrence[30]["alpha"],
        recurrence[31]["alpha"],
        pilot_z30,
        pilot_z31,
        pilot_z32,
    )
    correction = _track(
        folded["array_ledger"],
        "correction",
        fnp.matmul(coefficients[None, :], folded["features"])[0],
    )
    final_mean = fnp.add(folded["final_mean"], correction)
    return {
        "final_mean": final_mean,
        "prediction": fnp.concatenate(
            (fnp.zeros((DEPTH - 1, WIDTH), dtype=fnp.float32), final_mean[None, :]),
            axis=0,
        ),
        "features": folded["features"],
        "class_counts": folded["class_counts"],
        "feature_class_counts": folded["class_counts"],
        "array_ledger": folded["array_ledger"],
        "prefix_layers": layers,
        "active_widths": [int(mask.shape[0]) for mask in masks],
        "pilot_live_widths": pilot_live_widths,
    }

def _rotation_row(base: Any, network_seed: int, rotation_index: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    _, screen, legal_gate = dependencies()
    offset = ROTATION_OFFSETS[rotation_index]
    mlp = legal_gate.network_with_rotation(base, network_seed + offset)
    signs = screen.signs_for(mlp.seed)
    codes = screen.codes()
    baseline, baseline_measure = baseline_prediction(mlp.weights, codes, signs)
    candidate, candidate_measure = candidate_prediction(mlp.weights, codes, signs, np.zeros(3))
    direct = np.asarray(baseline["prediction"], dtype=np.float32)
    zero = np.asarray(candidate["prediction"], dtype=np.float32)
    features = np.asarray(candidate["features"], dtype=np.float32)
    baseline_multiplier = multiplier_reconciliation(float(baseline_measure["effective_compute"]))
    candidate_multiplier = multiplier_reconciliation(float(candidate_measure["effective_compute"]))
    feature_norms = np.linalg.norm(features.astype(np.float64), axis=1)
    checks = {
        "zero_beta_bitwise_e141_parity": bool(np.array_equal(direct, zero)),
        "baseline_shape": bool(direct.shape == (DEPTH, WIDTH)),
        "candidate_shape": bool(zero.shape == (DEPTH, WIDTH)),
        "features_shape": bool(features.shape == (3, WIDTH)),
        "features_finite": bool(np.all(np.isfinite(features))),
        "features_nonzero": bool(np.all(feature_norms > 0.0)),
        "baseline_finite": bool(np.all(np.isfinite(direct))),
        "candidate_finite": bool(np.all(np.isfinite(zero))),
        "baseline_ledger_reconciles": bool(baseline_measure["operations_reconcile"]),
        "candidate_ledger_reconciles": bool(candidate_measure["operations_reconcile"]),
        "baseline_budget": int(baseline_measure["flops_used"]) <= FLOP_BUDGET,
        "candidate_budget": int(candidate_measure["flops_used"]) <= FLOP_BUDGET,
        "multiplier_reconciles": bool(
            baseline_multiplier["reconciles"] and candidate_multiplier["reconciles"]
        ),
    }
    return {
        "network_seed": network_seed,
        "rotation_index": rotation_index,
        "rotation_offset": offset,
        "mlp": mlp,
        "codes": codes,
        "signs": signs,
        "sign_hash": array_hash(signs),
        "baseline_final_mean": np.asarray(baseline["final_mean"], dtype=np.float32),
        "features": features,
        "baseline_measure": baseline_measure,
        "candidate_measure": candidate_measure,
        "baseline_multiplier": float(baseline_multiplier["official"]),
        "baseline_multiplier_manual": float(baseline_multiplier["manual"]),
        "candidate_multiplier": float(candidate_multiplier["official"]),
        "candidate_multiplier_manual": float(candidate_multiplier["manual"]),
        "incremental_flops": int(candidate_measure["flops_used"])
        - int(baseline_measure["flops_used"]),
        "largest_feature_array_bytes": max(
            int(entry["bytes"]) for entry in candidate["array_ledger"].values()
        ),
        "class_counts": candidate["class_counts"],
        "feature_class_counts": candidate["feature_class_counts"],
        "feature_norms": feature_norms.tolist(),
        "checks": checks,
        "all_checks_pass": all(checks.values()),
    }


def _permuted_weights(weights: Sequence[fnp.ndarray]) -> list[fnp.ndarray]:
    permutation_rng = np.random.default_rng(PRECHECK_SEED)
    p30 = fnp.asarray(permutation_rng.permutation(WIDTH), dtype=fnp.int64)
    p31 = fnp.asarray(permutation_rng.permutation(WIDTH), dtype=fnp.int64)
    result = list(weights)
    result[29] = weights[29][:, p30]
    result[30] = weights[30][p30, :][:, p31]
    result[31] = weights[31][p31, :]
    return result


def permutation_covariance(row: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    permuted, measure_result = candidate_prediction(
        _permuted_weights(row["mlp"].weights),
        row["codes"],
        row["signs"],
        np.zeros(3),
    )
    original_features = np.asarray(row["features"], dtype=np.float64)
    permuted_features = np.asarray(permuted["features"], dtype=np.float64)
    original_final = np.asarray(row["baseline_final_mean"], dtype=np.float64)
    permuted_final = np.asarray(permuted["final_mean"], dtype=np.float64)
    feature_error = float(np.max(np.abs(original_features - permuted_features)))
    final_error = float(np.max(np.abs(original_final - permuted_final)))
    checks = {
        "features_close": bool(
            np.allclose(
                original_features, permuted_features, rtol=PERMUTATION_RTOL, atol=PERMUTATION_ATOL
            )
        ),
        "final_close": bool(
            np.allclose(
                original_final, permuted_final, rtol=PERMUTATION_RTOL, atol=PERMUTATION_ATOL
            )
        ),
        "ledger_reconciles": bool(measure_result["operations_reconcile"]),
        "within_budget": int(measure_result["flops_used"]) <= FLOP_BUDGET,
    }
    return {
        "maximum_feature_absolute_error": feature_error,
        "maximum_final_absolute_error": final_error,
        "measure": measure_result,
        "checks": checks,
        "all_checks_pass": all(checks.values()),
    }


def mc_truth(weights: Sequence[np.ndarray], seed: int) -> np.ndarray:
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    total = np.zeros(WIDTH, dtype=np.float64)
    complete = 0
    while complete < TRUTH_PAIRS:
        count = min(TRUTH_CHUNK_PAIRS, TRUTH_PAIRS - complete)
        half = rng.standard_normal((count, WIDTH), dtype=np.float32)
        activations = np.concatenate((half, -half), axis=0)
        for weight in weights:
            activations = np.maximum(activations @ weight, np.float32(0.0))
        total += np.sum(activations, axis=0, dtype=np.float64)
        complete += count
    return total / float(2 * TRUTH_PAIRS)


def fit_global_beta(
    rows: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], targets: Sequence[np.ndarray]
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if len(rows) != len(targets):
        raise ValueError("one independent train target is required per rotation row")
    base = np.asarray([row["baseline_final_mean"] for row in rows], dtype=np.float64)
    features = np.asarray([row["features"] for row in rows], dtype=np.float64)
    target = np.asarray(targets, dtype=np.float64)
    x = np.transpose(features, (0, 2, 1)).reshape(-1, 3)
    y = (target - base).reshape(-1)
    feature_scale = np.maximum(np.sqrt(np.mean(x * x, axis=0)), 1.0e-12)
    target_scale = max(float(np.sqrt(np.mean(y * y))), 1.0e-12)
    x_scaled = x / feature_scale
    y_scaled = y / target_scale
    gram = x_scaled.T @ x_scaled
    ridge_lambda = RIDGE_FRACTION * float(np.trace(gram)) / 3.0
    unbounded = np.linalg.solve(gram + ridge_lambda * np.eye(3), x_scaled.T @ y_scaled)
    bounded = np.clip(
        unbounded,
        -NORMALIZED_COEFFICIENT_BOUND,
        NORMALIZED_COEFFICIENT_BOUND,
    )
    beta = bounded * target_scale / feature_scale
    valid = bool(
        np.all(np.isfinite(beta))
        and np.all(np.isfinite(feature_scale))
        and math.isfinite(target_scale)
        and math.isfinite(ridge_lambda)
    )
    return {
        "beta": beta,
        "feature_scale": feature_scale,
        "target_scale": target_scale,
        "ridge_lambda": ridge_lambda,
        "normalized_unbounded": unbounded,
        "normalized_bounded": bounded,
        "valid": valid,
    }


def crossed_loss(prediction: np.ndarray, left: np.ndarray, right: np.ndarray) -> float:
    estimate = np.asarray(prediction, dtype=np.float64)
    return float(
        np.mean(
            (estimate - np.asarray(left, dtype=np.float64))
            * (estimate - np.asarray(right, dtype=np.float64))
        )
    )


def materialize_candidate(row: dict[str, Any], beta: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:
    candidate, candidate_measure = candidate_prediction(
        row["mlp"].weights, row["codes"], row["signs"], beta
    )
    candidate_multiplier = multiplier_reconciliation(float(candidate_measure["effective_compute"]))
    features = np.asarray(candidate["features"], dtype=np.float32)
    checks = {
        "feature_replay_exact": bool(np.array_equal(features, row["features"])),
        "finite_prediction": bool(np.all(np.isfinite(np.asarray(candidate["prediction"])))),
        "ledger_reconciles": bool(candidate_measure["operations_reconcile"]),
        "within_budget": int(candidate_measure["flops_used"]) <= FLOP_BUDGET,
        "multiplier_reconciles": bool(candidate_multiplier["reconciles"]),
    }
    return {
        "final_mean": np.asarray(candidate["final_mean"], dtype=np.float32),
        "measure": candidate_measure,
        "multiplier": float(candidate_multiplier["official"]),
        "multiplier_manual": float(candidate_multiplier["manual"]),
        "checks": checks,
        "all_checks_pass": all(checks.values()),
    }


def _score_pairs(
    rows: Sequence[dict[str, Any]],
    truths: Sequence[np.ndarray],
    beta: np.ndarray,
    pairs: Sequence[tuple[int, int]],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    scored = []
    for row in rows:
        candidate = materialize_candidate(row, beta)
        products = []
        for left, right in pairs:
            baseline_loss = crossed_loss(row["baseline_final_mean"], truths[left], truths[right])
            candidate_loss = crossed_loss(candidate["final_mean"], truths[left], truths[right])
            baseline_multiplier = float(row["baseline_multiplier"])
            candidate_multiplier = float(candidate["multiplier"])
            products.append(
                {
                    "truth_replicates": [left, right],
                    "baseline_cross_loss": baseline_loss,
                    "candidate_cross_loss": candidate_loss,
                    "baseline_multiplier": baseline_multiplier,
                    "candidate_multiplier": candidate_multiplier,
                    "baseline_adjusted_product": baseline_loss * baseline_multiplier,
                    "candidate_adjusted_product": candidate_loss * candidate_multiplier,
                    "conservative_e140_official_product": candidate_multiplier
                    * ((1.0 - ATTENUATION) * baseline_loss + ATTENUATION * candidate_loss),
                }
            )
        scored.append(
            {
                "rotation_index": int(row["rotation_index"]),
                "candidate_measure": candidate["measure"],
                "candidate_checks": candidate["checks"],
                "truth_cross_products": products,
            }
        )
    products = [product for row in scored for product in row["truth_cross_products"]]
    raw_baseline = sum(product["baseline_cross_loss"] for product in products)
    raw_candidate = sum(product["candidate_cross_loss"] for product in products)
    adjusted_baseline = sum(product["baseline_adjusted_product"] for product in products)
    adjusted_candidate = sum(product["candidate_adjusted_product"] for product in products)
    conservative_official = sum(
        product["conservative_e140_official_product"] for product in products
    )
    raw_ratio = raw_candidate / raw_baseline if raw_baseline > 0.0 else math.nan
    local_adjusted_ratio = (
        adjusted_candidate / adjusted_baseline if adjusted_baseline > 0.0 else math.nan
    )
    return {
        "beta": np.asarray(beta, dtype=np.float64),
        "truth_cross_product_count": len(products),
        "per_rotation": scored,
        "raw_baseline_loss": raw_baseline,
        "raw_candidate_loss": raw_candidate,
        "raw_ratio": raw_ratio,
        "local_adjusted_baseline_product": adjusted_baseline,
        "local_adjusted_candidate_product": adjusted_candidate,
        "local_adjusted_ratio": local_adjusted_ratio,
        "conservative_e140_official_numerator": conservative_official,
        "conservative_e140_official_ratio": (
            conservative_official / adjusted_baseline if adjusted_baseline > 0.0 else math.nan
        ),
        "legacy_e140_attenuation_ratio": (
            1.0 + ATTENUATION * (local_adjusted_ratio - 1.0)
            if math.isfinite(local_adjusted_ratio)
            else math.nan
        ),
        "all_candidate_prediction_checks": all(
            all(bool(value) for value in row["candidate_checks"].values()) for row in scored
        ),
    }


def deployable_score(
    rows: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], truths: Sequence[np.ndarray], beta: np.ndarray
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    pairs = tuple(
        (left, right)
        for left in range(HELDOUT_TRUTH_REPLICATES)
        for right in range(left + 1, HELDOUT_TRUTH_REPLICATES)
    )
    return _score_pairs(rows, truths, beta, pairs)


def impossible_oracle_score(
    rows: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], truths: Sequence[np.ndarray]

    directions = []
    for name, fit_ids, score_ids in (
        ("fit_01_score_23", (0, 1), (2, 3)),

def bootstrap(networks: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], section: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    baseline = np.asarray(
        [network[section]["local_adjusted_baseline_product"] for network in networks],
        dtype=np.float64,
    )
    candidate = np.asarray(
        [network[section]["local_adjusted_candidate_product"] for network in networks],
        dtype=np.float64,
    )
    rng = np.random.default_rng(BOOTSTRAP_SEED)
    indices = rng.integers(0, len(networks), size=(BOOTSTRAP_RESAMPLES, len(networks)))
    denominators = np.sum(baseline[indices], axis=1)
    valid = denominators > 0.0
    ratios = np.sum(candidate[indices], axis=1)[valid] / denominators[valid]
    q05, q50, q95 = np.quantile(ratios, (0.05, 0.5, 0.95)) if ratios.size else (math.nan,) * 3
    return {
        "seed": BOOTSTRAP_SEED,
        "resamples": BOOTSTRAP_RESAMPLES,
        "unit": "whole_network_score_grain",
        "valid_resamples": int(np.sum(valid)),
        "invalid_nonpositive_baseline_resamples": int(np.sum(~valid)),
        "q05": float(q05),
        "q50": float(q50),
        "q95": float(q95),
        "q95_descriptive_only": True,
    }


def summarize(networks: Sequence[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    deployable_baseline = sum(
        network["deployable"]["local_adjusted_baseline_product"] for network in networks
    )
    deployable_candidate = sum(
        network["deployable"]["local_adjusted_candidate_product"] for network in networks
    )
    deployable_raw_baseline = sum(
        network["deployable"]["raw_baseline_loss"] for network in networks
    )
    deployable_raw_candidate = sum(
        network["deployable"]["raw_candidate_loss"] for network in networks
    )
    deployable_conservative_official = sum(
        network["deployable"]["conservative_e140_official_numerator"] for network in networks
    )
    oracle_baseline = sum(
        network["impossible_oracle"]["local_adjusted_baseline_product"] for network in networks
    )
    oracle_candidate = sum(
        network["impossible_oracle"]["local_adjusted_candidate_product"] for network in networks
    )
    deployable_ratio = (
        deployable_candidate / deployable_baseline if deployable_baseline > 0.0 else math.nan
    )
    deployable_conservative_official_ratio = (
        deployable_conservative_official / deployable_baseline
        if deployable_baseline > 0.0
        else math.nan
    )
    oracle_ratio = oracle_candidate / oracle_baseline if oracle_baseline > 0.0 else math.nan
    deployable_bootstrap = bootstrap(networks, "deployable")
    oracle_bootstrap = bootstrap(networks, "impossible_oracle")
    deployable_legal = all(bool(network["checks"]["deployable_legality"]) for network in networks)
    oracle_legal = all(bool(network["checks"]["oracle_legality"]) for network in networks)
    if not oracle_legal:
        rank5_status = "kill_legality"
    elif oracle_bootstrap["invalid_nonpositive_baseline_resamples"]:
        rank5_status = "ambiguous_nonpositive_baseline"
    elif oracle_bootstrap["q05"] > TAU:
        rank5_status = "kill_rank5_capacity"
    else:
        rank5_status = "not_killed_by_q05"
    deployable_positive = bool(
        deployable_legal
        and math.isfinite(deployable_conservative_official_ratio)
        and deployable_conservative_official_ratio < 1.0
    )
    follow_up = (
        "authorize_broader_fresh_network_deployable_gate"
        if deployable_positive
        else "kill_e157_deployable_head"
    )
    return {
        "network_count": len(networks),
        "deployable": {
            "aggregate_raw_ratio": deployable_raw_candidate / deployable_raw_baseline
            if deployable_raw_baseline > 0.0
            else math.nan,

            "aggregate_conservative_e140_official_ratio": deployable_conservative_official_ratio,

                else math.nan

                network["deployable"]["local_adjusted_ratio"] for network in networks

            "bootstrap": deployable_bootstrap,
            "legality": deployable_legal,
            "truth_independent_beta": True,
        },
        "impossible_oracle": {
            "aggregate_local_adjusted_ratio": oracle_ratio,
            "per_network_local_adjusted_ratio": [
                network["impossible_oracle"]["local_adjusted_ratio"] for network in networks
            ],
            "bootstrap": oracle_bootstrap,

EXACT_ZERO_PILOT_GAP = 48

PILOT_ROWS = 1_652


def pilot_classification(
    first_activations: fnp.ndarray,
    weights: Sequence[fnp.ndarray],
    recurrence: list[dict[str, fnp.ndarray]],
) -> tuple[list[fnp.ndarray], fnp.ndarray, list[int]]:

    masks = [fnp.arange(WIDTH, dtype=fnp.int64)]

        int(
            fnp.nonzero(
                fnp.any(
                    pilot > fnp.float32(0.0),
                    axis=0,
                )
            )[0].shape[0]
        )
    ]
    for weight_index, weight in enumerate(weights[1:LATE_START], start=1):
        pre = fnp.matmul(pilot, weight)
        rows = fnp.reshape(pre, (-1, WIDTH))
        dead = fnp.logical_and(
            recurrence[weight_index]["alpha"] < ALPHA_DEAD,
            fnp.all(rows <= fnp.float32(0.0), axis=0),
        )
        masks.append(fnp.nonzero(fnp.logical_not(dead))[0])
        pilot = fnp.maximum(pre, fnp.float32(0.0))
        active_pilot = pilot[:, masks[-1]]
        pilot_live_widths.append(
            int(
                fnp.nonzero(
                    fnp.any(
                        fnp.reshape(
                            active_pilot,
                            (-1, active_pilot.shape[-1]),
                        )
                        > fnp.float32(0.0),
                        axis=0,
                    )
                )[0].shape[0]
            )
        )
    return masks, pilot, pilot_live_widths


def select_route(
    active_input_width: int,
    active_output_width: int,
    pilot_live_input_width: int,
) -> str:
    if active_input_width == WIDTH and active_output_width == WIDTH:
        return "chunked_e136"
    if pilot_live_input_width <= active_input_width - EXACT_ZERO_PILOT_GAP:
        return "exact_zero_after_dead"
    if active_input_width <= COLD_ACTIVE_MAX and active_output_width <= COLD_ACTIVE_MAX:
        return "dead_cold"
    return "analytic_dead_dense"


def compact_prefix(

    weights: Sequence[fnp.ndarray],
    recurrence: list[dict[str, fnp.ndarray]],

    pilot_live_widths: list[int],

    for layer, weight in enumerate(weights[1:LATE_START], start=2):

            int(active_ids.shape[0]),
            int(output_ids.shape[0]),
            pilot_live_widths[layer - 2],

        local_output_ids = fnp.arange(output_ids.shape[0], dtype=fnp.int64)
        active_weight = selected_weight[:, output_ids]
        bias = None

            previous_mean = recurrence[layer - 2]["mean"]
            full_mean = fnp.matmul(
                previous_mean[None, :],
                weight[:, output_ids],

            active_mean = fnp.matmul(
                previous_mean[active_ids][None, :],
                active_weight,
            )[0]
            bias = full_mean - active_mean
        if route == "exact_zero_after_dead":
            activations, info = screen.exact_zero_relu(
                activations,
                active_weight,
                bias,

        elif route == "dead_cold":

                activations,
                active_weight,
                local_ids,
                local_output_ids,

                active_weight,
                local_ids,
                local_output_ids,
                bias,

                "active_input_width": int(active_ids.shape[0]),

                "pilot_live_input_width": pilot_live_widths[layer - 2],

                        "padded_input_width",

                    info.get(
                        "padded_output_width",
                        output_ids.shape[0],

    w31: fnp.ndarray,
    w32: fnp.ndarray,
    analytic_mean29: fnp.ndarray,
    analytic_mean30: fnp.ndarray,
    analytic_mean31: fnp.ndarray,
    analytic_mean32: fnp.ndarray,
    alpha30: fnp.ndarray,

    p31 = e136._partition(alpha31, pilot_z31)

    full_mean30 = e136._matmul_or_zero(analytic_mean29[None, :], w30)[0]

        analytic_mean29[active29][None, :],
        w30_active,

        e136._matmul_or_zero(a30_k, e136._block(w31, k30, k31))

            a29,
            e136._matmul_or_zero(
                w30_active[:, o30],
                e136._block(w31, o30, k31),
            ),

            e136._block(w31, o30, k31),

            analytic_mean30[d30][None, :],
            e136._block(w31, d30, k31),

            analytic_mean30[d30][None, :],
            e136._block(w31, d30, o31),

            mean_o30[None, :],
            e136._block(w31, o30, o31),
        )[0]
        + e136._matmul_or_zero(
            mean_k30[None, :],
            e136._block(w31, k30, o31),

            e136._matmul_or_zero(

        + e136._matmul_or_zero(
            analytic_mean30[d30][None, :],
            e136._block(w31, d30, o31),
        )
    )

    z32_k = (
        e136._matmul_or_zero(a31_k, e136._block(w32, k31, k32))
        + e136._matmul_or_zero(z31_o, e136._block(w32, o31, k32))

            analytic_mean31[d31][None, :],
            e136._block(w32, d31, k32),

        e136._mean_rows(
            fnp.maximum(z32_k, fnp.float32(0.0)),
            k32.shape[0],
        )
        if k32.shape[0]
        else fnp.zeros(0, dtype=a29.dtype)
    )
    mean_o32 = (
        e136._matmul_or_zero(
            analytic_mean31[d31][None, :],
            e136._block(w32, d31, o32),
        )[0]
        + e136._matmul_or_zero(
            mean_o31[None, :],
            e136._block(w32, o31, o32),
        )[0]
        + e136._matmul_or_zero(
            mean_k31[None, :],
            e136._block(w32, k31, o32),
        )[0]
    )
    final_mean = (
        e136._map_subset(analytic_mean32[d32], d32, WIDTH)
        + e136._map_subset(mean_o32, o32, WIDTH)
        + e136._map_subset(mean_k32, k32, WIDTH)

    return {

            "layer31": {name: int(ids.shape[0]) for name, ids in p31.items()},

    }


def predict_with_diagnostics(
    weights: Sequence[fnp.ndarray],
    codes: fnp.ndarray,

        recurrence[28]["mean"],
        recurrence[29]["mean"],
        recurrence[30]["mean"],
        recurrence[31]["mean"],
        recurrence[29]["alpha"],
        recurrence[30]["alpha"],
        recurrence[31]["alpha"],
        pilot_z30,
        pilot_z31,
        pilot_z32,
    )
    folded["prefix_layers"] = layers
    folded["active_widths"] = [int(mask.shape[0]) for mask in masks]
    folded["pilot_live_widths"] = pilot_live_widths
    folded["masks"] = masks
    folded["prediction"] = fnp.concatenate(
        (
            fnp.zeros((DEPTH - 1, WIDTH), dtype=fnp.float32),
            folded["final_mean"][None, :],
        ),
        axis=0,
    )
    return folded

        and preregistration["reserved_result"]["must_be_absent_before_target_run"]
        and reserved.exists()
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(f"reserved result already exists: {reserved}")
    return {
        "runtime": installed,
        "source_hashes": hashes,
        "preregistration_canonical_sha256": actual_preregistration_hash,
        "parent_commit": parent,
        "fresh_seeds_absent_at_parent": novelty,
        "reserved_result_absent": not reserved.exists(),
    }


def measure(screen: Any, context: flops.BudgetContext) -> dict[str, Any]:
    summary = screen.measure(context)
    return {
        "flops_used": int(summary["flops_used"]),
        "effective_compute": float(summary["effective_compute"]),
        "wall_time_s": float(summary["wall_time_s"]),
        "residual_wall_time_s": float(summary["residual_wall_time_s"]),
        "operations": summary["operations"],
        "operations_reconcile": bool(summary["operations_reconcile"]),
    }


def multiplier_reconciliation(effective_compute: float) -> dict[str, float | bool]:
    official = float(score_multiplier(effective_compute, float(FLOP_BUDGET), failed=False))
    manual = max(0.1, effective_compute / float(FLOP_BUDGET))
    return {"official": official, "manual": manual, "reconciles": official == manual}


def _array_bytes(value: fnp.ndarray) -> int:
    return math.prod(value.shape) * np.dtype(value.dtype).itemsize


def _track(ledger: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], name: str, value: fnp.ndarray) -> fnp.ndarray:
    ledger[name] = {"shape": list(value.shape), "bytes": _array_bytes(value)}
    return value


def _compact_late_fold_and_residuals(
    e141: Any,
    a29: fnp.ndarray,
    active29: fnp.ndarray,
    w30: fnp.ndarray,
    w31: fnp.ndarray,
    w32: fnp.ndarray,
    analytic_mean29: fnp.ndarray,
    analytic_mean30: fnp.ndarray,
    analytic_mean31: fnp.ndarray,
    analytic_mean32: fnp.ndarray,
    alpha30: fnp.ndarray,
    alpha31: fnp.ndarray,
    alpha32: fnp.ndarray,
    pilot_z30: fnp.ndarray,
    pilot_z31: fnp.ndarray,
    pilot_z32: fnp.ndarray,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    p30 = e141._partition(alpha30, pilot_z30)
    p31 = e141._partition(alpha31, pilot_z31)
    p32 = e141._partition(alpha32, pilot_z32)
    d30, o30, k30 = p30["dead"], p30["on"], p30["kink"]
    d31, o31, k31 = p31["dead"], p31["on"], p31["kink"]
    d32, o32, k32 = p32["dead"], p32["on"], p32["kink"]
    w30_active = w30[active29, :]
    mean_a29 = e141._mean_rows(a29, active29.shape[0])
    full_mean30 = e141._matmul_or_zero(analytic_mean29[None, :], w30)[0]
    active_mean30 = e141._matmul_or_zero(analytic_mean29[active29][None, :], w30_active)[0]
    dead_bias30 = full_mean30 - active_mean30

    z30_k = e141._matmul_or_zero(a29, w30_active[:, k30]) + dead_bias30[k30]
    a30_k = fnp.maximum(z30_k, fnp.float32(0.0))
    mean_k30 = (
        e141._mean_rows(a30_k, k30.shape[0]) if k30.shape[0] else fnp.zeros(0, dtype=a29.dtype)
    )
    mean_o30 = (
        e141._matmul_or_zero(
            mean_a29[None, :],
            w30_active[:, o30],
        )[0]
        + dead_bias30[o30]
    )
    z31_k = (
        e141._matmul_or_zero(a30_k, e141._block(w31, k30, k31))
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(
            a29,
            e141._matmul_or_zero(w30_active[:, o30], e141._block(w31, o30, k31)),
        )
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(dead_bias30[o30][None, :], e141._block(w31, o30, k31))
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(analytic_mean30[d30][None, :], e141._block(w31, d30, k31))
    )
    a31_k = fnp.maximum(z31_k, fnp.float32(0.0))
    mean_k31 = (
        e141._mean_rows(a31_k, k31.shape[0]) if k31.shape[0] else fnp.zeros(0, dtype=a29.dtype)
    )
    mean_o31 = (
        e141._matmul_or_zero(
            analytic_mean30[d30][None, :],
            e141._block(w31, d30, o31),
        )[0]
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(
            mean_o30[None, :],
            e141._block(w31, o30, o31),
        )[0]
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(
            mean_k30[None, :],
            e141._block(w31, k30, o31),
        )[0]
    )
    z31_o = (
        e141._matmul_or_zero(a30_k, e141._block(w31, k30, o31))
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(
            a29,
            e141._matmul_or_zero(w30_active[:, o30], e141._block(w31, o30, o31)),
        )
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(dead_bias30[o30][None, :], e141._block(w31, o30, o31))
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(analytic_mean30[d30][None, :], e141._block(w31, d30, o31))
    )
    z32_k = (
        e141._matmul_or_zero(a31_k, e141._block(w32, k31, k32))
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(z31_o, e141._block(w32, o31, k32))
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(analytic_mean31[d31][None, :], e141._block(w32, d31, k32))
    )
    mean_k32 = (
        e141._mean_rows(fnp.maximum(z32_k, fnp.float32(0.0)), k32.shape[0])
        if k32.shape[0]
        else fnp.zeros(0, dtype=a29.dtype)
    )
    mean_o32 = (
        e141._matmul_or_zero(
            analytic_mean31[d31][None, :],
            e141._block(w32, d31, o32),
        )[0]
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(
            mean_o31[None, :],
            e141._block(w32, o31, o32),
        )[0]
        + e141._matmul_or_zero(
            mean_k31[None, :],
            e141._block(w32, k31, o32),
        )[0]
    )
    final_mean = (
        e141._map_subset(analytic_mean32[d32], d32, WIDTH)
        + e141._map_subset(mean_o32, o32, WIDTH)
        + e141._map_subset(mean_k32, k32, WIDTH)
    )
    ledger: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    r30 = _track(
        ledger,
        "r30",
        e141._map_subset(mean_k30 - analytic_mean30[k30], k30, WIDTH),
    )
    r31 = _track(
        ledger,
        "r31",
        e141._map_subset(mean_k31 - analytic_mean31[k31], k31, WIDTH),
    )
    r32 = _track(
        ledger,
        "r32",
        e141._map_subset(mean_k32 - analytic_mean32[k32], k32, WIDTH),
    )
    g31 = _track(
        ledger,
        "g31",
        fnp.asarray(flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha31), dtype=fnp.float32),
    )
    g32 = _track(
        ledger,
        "g32",
        fnp.asarray(flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha32), dtype=fnp.float32),
    )
    t30 = _track(
        ledger,
        "t30",
        fnp.multiply(
            fnp.matmul(
                fnp.multiply(fnp.matmul(r30, w31), g31),
                w32,
            ),
            g32,
        ),
    )
    t31 = _track(ledger, "t31", fnp.multiply(fnp.matmul(r31, w32), g32))
    features = _track(ledger, "features", fnp.stack((t30, t31, r32), axis=0))
    return {
        "final_mean": final_mean,
        "features": features,
        "class_counts": {
            "layer30": {name: int(ids.shape[0]) for name, ids in p30.items()},
            "layer31": {name: int(ids.shape[0]) for name, ids in p31.items()},
            "layer32": {name: int(ids.shape[0]) for name, ids in p32.items()},
        },
        "array_ledger": ledger,
    }


def e157_prediction(
    weights: Sequence[fnp.ndarray],
    codes: fnp.ndarray,
    signs: fnp.ndarray,
    beta: np.ndarray | Sequence[float],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    e141, _, _ = dependencies()
    if len(weights) != DEPTH or weights[0].shape != (WIDTH, WIDTH):
        raise ValueError("e157 requires a 32-layer width-256 MLP")
    coefficients = fnp.asarray(np.asarray(beta, dtype=np.float32), dtype=fnp.float32)
    if coefficients.shape != (3,):
        raise ValueError("e157 requires exactly three shared scalar coefficients")
    recurrence = e141.diagonal_gaussian_recurrence(weights)
    first = e141.antipodal_kerdock_activations(weights[0], codes, signs)
    masks, pilot_a29, pilot_live_widths = e141.pilot_classification(first, weights, recurrence)
    a29, layers = e141.compact_prefix(first, weights, recurrence, masks, pilot_live_widths)
    pilot_z30 = fnp.matmul(pilot_a29, weights[29])
    pilot_z31 = fnp.matmul(fnp.maximum(pilot_z30, fnp.float32(0.0)), weights[30])
    pilot_z32 = fnp.matmul(fnp.maximum(pilot_z31, fnp.float32(0.0)), weights[31])
    folded = _compact_late_fold_and_residuals(
        e141,
        a29,
        masks[-1],
        weights[29],
        weights[30],
        weights[31],
        recurrence[28]["mean"],
        recurrence[29]["mean"],
        recurrence[30]["mean"],
        recurrence[31]["mean"],
        recurrence[29]["alpha"],
        recurrence[30]["alpha"],
        recurrence[31]["alpha"],
        pilot_z30,
        pilot_z31,
        pilot_z32,
    )
    correction = _track(
        folded["array_ledger"],
        "correction",
        fnp.matmul(coefficients[None, :], folded["features"])[0],
    )
    final_mean = fnp.add(folded["final_mean"], correction)
    return {
        "final_mean": final_mean,
        "prediction": fnp.concatenate(
            (fnp.zeros((DEPTH - 1, WIDTH), dtype=fnp.float32), final_mean[None, :]),
            axis=0,
        ),
        "features": folded["features"],
        "class_counts": folded["class_counts"],
        "feature_class_counts": folded["class_counts"],
        "array_ledger": folded["array_ledger"],
        "prefix_layers": layers,
        "active_widths": [int(mask.shape[0]) for mask in masks],
        "pilot_live_widths": pilot_live_widths,
    }


def baseline_prediction(
    weights: Sequence[fnp.ndarray], codes: fnp.ndarray, signs: fnp.ndarray
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    e141, screen, _ = dependencies()
    with flops.BudgetContext(flop_budget=FLOP_BUDGET, quiet=True) as context:
        result = e141.e141_predict_with_diagnostics(weights, codes, signs)
    return result, measure(screen, context)


def candidate_prediction(
    weights: Sequence[fnp.ndarray],
    codes: fnp.ndarray,
    signs: fnp.ndarray,
    beta: np.ndarray | Sequence[float],
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:

def _rotation_row(base: Any, network_seed: int, rotation_index: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    _, screen, legal_gate = dependencies()
    offset = ROTATION_OFFSETS[rotation_index]
    mlp = legal_gate.network_with_rotation(base, network_seed + offset)
    signs = screen.signs_for(mlp.seed)
    codes = screen.codes()
    baseline, baseline_measure = baseline_prediction(mlp.weights, codes, signs)
    candidate, candidate_measure = candidate_prediction(mlp.weights, codes, signs, np.zeros(3))
    direct = np.asarray(baseline["prediction"], dtype=np.float32)
    zero = np.asarray(candidate["prediction"], dtype=np.float32)
    features = np.asarray(candidate["features"], dtype=np.float32)
    baseline_multiplier = multiplier_reconciliation(float(baseline_measure["effective_compute"]))
    candidate_multiplier = multiplier_reconciliation(float(candidate_measure["effective_compute"]))
    feature_norms = np.linalg.norm(features.astype(np.float64), axis=1)
    checks = {
        "zero_beta_bitwise_e141_parity": bool(np.array_equal(direct, zero)),
        "baseline_shape": bool(direct.shape == (DEPTH, WIDTH)),
        "candidate_shape": bool(zero.shape == (DEPTH, WIDTH)),
        "features_shape": bool(features.shape == (3, WIDTH)),
        "features_finite": bool(np.all(np.isfinite(features))),
        "features_nonzero": bool(np.all(feature_norms > 0.0)),
        "baseline_finite": bool(np.all(np.isfinite(direct))),
        "candidate_finite": bool(np.all(np.isfinite(zero))),
        "baseline_ledger_reconciles": bool(baseline_measure["operations_reconcile"]),
        "candidate_ledger_reconciles": bool(candidate_measure["operations_reconcile"]),
        "baseline_budget": int(baseline_measure["flops_used"]) <= FLOP_BUDGET,
        "candidate_budget": int(candidate_measure["flops_used"]) <= FLOP_BUDGET,
        "multiplier_reconciles": bool(
            baseline_multiplier["reconciles"] and candidate_multiplier["reconciles"]
        ),
    }
    return {
        "network_seed": network_seed,
        "rotation_index": rotation_index,
        "rotation_offset": offset,
        "mlp": mlp,
        "codes": codes,
        "signs": signs,
        "sign_hash": array_hash(signs),
        "baseline_final_mean": np.asarray(baseline["final_mean"], dtype=np.float32),
        "features": features,
        "baseline_measure": baseline_measure,
        "candidate_measure": candidate_measure,
        "baseline_multiplier": float(baseline_multiplier["official"]),
        "baseline_multiplier_manual": float(baseline_multiplier["manual"]),
        "candidate_multiplier": float(candidate_multiplier["official"]),
        "candidate_multiplier_manual": float(candidate_multiplier["manual"]),
        "incremental_flops": int(candidate_measure["flops_used"])
        - int(baseline_measure["flops_used"]),
        "largest_feature_array_bytes": max(
            int(entry["bytes"]) for entry in candidate["array_ledger"].values()
        ),
        "class_counts": candidate["class_counts"],
        "feature_class_counts": candidate["feature_class_counts"],
        "feature_norms": feature_norms.tolist(),
        "checks": checks,
        "all_checks_pass": all(checks.values()),
    }


def _permuted_weights(weights: Sequence[fnp.ndarray]) -> list[fnp.ndarray]:
    permutation_rng = np.random.default_rng(PRECHECK_SEED)
    p30 = fnp.asarray(permutation_rng.permutation(WIDTH), dtype=fnp.int64)
    p31 = fnp.asarray(permutation_rng.permutation(WIDTH), dtype=fnp.int64)
    result = list(weights)
    result[29] = weights[29][:, p30]
    result[30] = weights[30][p30, :][:, p31]
    result[31] = weights[31][p31, :]
    return result


def permutation_covariance(row: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    permuted, measure_result = candidate_prediction(
        _permuted_weights(row["mlp"].weights),
        row["codes"],
        row["signs"],
        np.zeros(3),
    )
    original_features = np.asarray(row["features"], dtype=np.float64)
    permuted_features = np.asarray(permuted["features"], dtype=np.float64)
    original_final = np.asarray(row["baseline_final_mean"], dtype=np.float64)
    permuted_final = np.asarray(permuted["final_mean"], dtype=np.float64)
    feature_error = float(np.max(np.abs(original_features - permuted_features)))
    final_error = float(np.max(np.abs(original_final - permuted_final)))
    checks = {
        "features_close": bool(
            np.allclose(
                original_features, permuted_features, rtol=PERMUTATION_RTOL, atol=PERMUTATION_ATOL
            )
        ),
        "final_close": bool(
            np.allclose(
                original_final, permuted_final, rtol=PERMUTATION_RTOL, atol=PERMUTATION_ATOL
            )
        ),
        "ledger_reconciles": bool(measure_result["operations_reconcile"]),
        "within_budget": int(measure_result["flops_used"]) <= FLOP_BUDGET,
    }
    return {
        "maximum_feature_absolute_error": feature_error,
        "maximum_final_absolute_error": final_error,
        "measure": measure_result,
        "checks": checks,
        "all_checks_pass": all(checks.values()),
    }


def mc_truth(weights: Sequence[np.ndarray], seed: int) -> np.ndarray:
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    total = np.zeros(WIDTH, dtype=np.float64)
    complete = 0
    while complete < TRUTH_PAIRS:
        count = min(TRUTH_CHUNK_PAIRS, TRUTH_PAIRS - complete)
        half = rng.standard_normal((count, WIDTH), dtype=np.float32)
        activations = np.concatenate((half, -half), axis=0)
        for weight in weights:
            activations = np.maximum(activations @ weight, np.float32(0.0))
        total += np.sum(activations, axis=0, dtype=np.float64)
        complete += count
    return total / float(2 * TRUTH_PAIRS)


def fit_global_beta(
    rows: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], targets: Sequence[np.ndarray]
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if len(rows) != len(targets):
        raise ValueError("one independent train target is required per rotation row")
    base = np.asarray([row["baseline_final_mean"] for row in rows], dtype=np.float64)
    features = np.asarray([row["features"] for row in rows], dtype=np.float64)
    target = np.asarray(targets, dtype=np.float64)
    x = np.transpose(features, (0, 2, 1)).reshape(-1, 3)
    y = (target - base).reshape(-1)
    feature_scale = np.maximum(np.sqrt(np.mean(x * x, axis=0)), 1.0e-12)
    target_scale = max(float(np.sqrt(np.mean(y * y))), 1.0e-12)
    x_scaled = x / feature_scale
    y_scaled = y / target_scale
    gram = x_scaled.T @ x_scaled
    ridge_lambda = RIDGE_FRACTION * float(np.trace(gram)) / 3.0
    unbounded = np.linalg.solve(gram + ridge_lambda * np.eye(3), x_scaled.T @ y_scaled)
    bounded = np.clip(
        unbounded,
        -NORMALIZED_COEFFICIENT_BOUND,
        NORMALIZED_COEFFICIENT_BOUND,
    )
    beta = bounded * target_scale / feature_scale
    valid = bool(
        np.all(np.isfinite(beta))
        and np.all(np.isfinite(feature_scale))
        and math.isfinite(target_scale)
        and math.isfinite(ridge_lambda)
    )
    return {
        "beta": beta,
        "feature_scale": feature_scale,
        "target_scale": target_scale,
        "ridge_lambda": ridge_lambda,
        "normalized_unbounded": unbounded,
        "normalized_bounded": bounded,
        "valid": valid,
    }


def crossed_loss(prediction: np.ndarray, left: np.ndarray, right: np.ndarray) -> float:
    estimate = np.asarray(prediction, dtype=np.float64)
    return float(
        np.mean(
            (estimate - np.asarray(left, dtype=np.float64))
            * (estimate - np.asarray(right, dtype=np.float64))
        )
    )


def materialize_candidate(row: dict[str, Any], beta: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:
    candidate, candidate_measure = candidate_prediction(
        row["mlp"].weights, row["codes"], row["signs"], beta
    )
    candidate_multiplier = multiplier_reconciliation(float(candidate_measure["effective_compute"]))
    features = np.asarray(candidate["features"], dtype=np.float32)
    checks = {
        "feature_replay_exact": bool(np.array_equal(features, row["features"])),
        "finite_prediction": bool(np.all(np.isfinite(np.asarray(candidate["prediction"])))),
        "ledger_reconciles": bool(candidate_measure["operations_reconcile"]),
        "within_budget": int(candidate_measure["flops_used"]) <= FLOP_BUDGET,
        "multiplier_reconciles": bool(candidate_multiplier["reconciles"]),
    }
    return {
        "final_mean": np.asarray(candidate["final_mean"], dtype=np.float32),
        "measure": candidate_measure,
        "multiplier": float(candidate_multiplier["official"]),
        "multiplier_manual": float(candidate_multiplier["manual"]),
        "checks": checks,
        "all_checks_pass": all(checks.values()),
    }


def _score_pairs(
    rows: Sequence[dict[str, Any]],
    truths: Sequence[np.ndarray],
    beta: np.ndarray,
    pairs: Sequence[tuple[int, int]],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    scored = []
    for row in rows:
        candidate = materialize_candidate(row, beta)
        products = []
        for left, right in pairs:
            baseline_loss = crossed_loss(row["baseline_final_mean"], truths[left], truths[right])
            candidate_loss = crossed_loss(candidate["final_mean"], truths[left], truths[right])
            baseline_multiplier = float(row["baseline_multiplier"])
            candidate_multiplier = float(candidate["multiplier"])
            products.append(
                {
                    "truth_replicates": [left, right],
                    "baseline_cross_loss": baseline_loss,
                    "candidate_cross_loss": candidate_loss,
                    "baseline_multiplier": baseline_multiplier,
                    "candidate_multiplier": candidate_multiplier,
                    "baseline_adjusted_product": baseline_loss * baseline_multiplier,
                    "candidate_adjusted_product": candidate_loss * candidate_multiplier,
                    "conservative_e140_official_product": candidate_multiplier
                    * ((1.0 - ATTENUATION) * baseline_loss + ATTENUATION * candidate_loss),
                }
            )
        scored.append(
            {
                "rotation_index": int(row["rotation_index"]),
                "candidate_measure": candidate["measure"],
                "candidate_checks": candidate["checks"],
                "truth_cross_products": products,
            }
        )
    products = [product for row in scored for product in row["truth_cross_products"]]
    raw_baseline = sum(product["baseline_cross_loss"] for product in products)
    raw_candidate = sum(product["candidate_cross_loss"] for product in products)
    adjusted_baseline = sum(product["baseline_adjusted_product"] for product in products)
    adjusted_candidate = sum(product["candidate_adjusted_product"] for product in products)
    conservative_official = sum(
        product["conservative_e140_official_product"] for product in products
    )
    raw_ratio = raw_candidate / raw_baseline if raw_baseline > 0.0 else math.nan
    local_adjusted_ratio = (
        adjusted_candidate / adjusted_baseline if adjusted_baseline > 0.0 else math.nan
    )
    return {
        "beta": np.asarray(beta, dtype=np.float64),
        "truth_cross_product_count": len(products),
        "per_rotation": scored,
        "raw_baseline_loss": raw_baseline,
        "raw_candidate_loss": raw_candidate,
        "raw_ratio": raw_ratio,
        "local_adjusted_baseline_product": adjusted_baseline,
        "local_adjusted_candidate_product": adjusted_candidate,
        "local_adjusted_ratio": local_adjusted_ratio,
        "conservative_e140_official_numerator": conservative_official,
        "conservative_e140_official_ratio": (
            conservative_official / adjusted_baseline if adjusted_baseline > 0.0 else math.nan
        ),
        "legacy_e140_attenuation_ratio": (
            1.0 + ATTENUATION * (local_adjusted_ratio - 1.0)
            if math.isfinite(local_adjusted_ratio)
            else math.nan
        ),
        "all_candidate_prediction_checks": all(
            all(bool(value) for value in row["candidate_checks"].values()) for row in scored
        ),
    }


def deployable_score(
    rows: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], truths: Sequence[np.ndarray], beta: np.ndarray
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    pairs = tuple(
        (left, right)
        for left in range(HELDOUT_TRUTH_REPLICATES)
        for right in range(left + 1, HELDOUT_TRUTH_REPLICATES)
    )
    return _score_pairs(rows, truths, beta, pairs)


def impossible_oracle_score(
    rows: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], truths: Sequence[np.ndarray]
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    directions = []
    for name, fit_ids, score_ids in (
        ("fit_01_score_23", (0, 1), (2, 3)),
        ("fit_23_score_01", (2, 3), (0, 1)),
    ):
        targets = [0.5 * (truths[fit_ids[0]] + truths[fit_ids[1]]) for _ in rows]
        fit = fit_global_beta(rows, targets)
        scored = _score_pairs(rows, truths, np.asarray(fit["beta"]), (score_ids,))
        directions.append(
            {
                "direction": name,
                "fit_truth_replicates": list(fit_ids),
                "score_truth_replicates": list(score_ids),

                "score": scored,

    return {
        "directions": directions,
        "local_adjusted_baseline_product": baseline,
        "local_adjusted_candidate_product": candidate,
        "local_adjusted_ratio": candidate / baseline if baseline > 0.0 else math.nan,
        "all_fits_valid": all(bool(direction["fit"]["valid"]) for direction in directions),

def bootstrap(networks: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], section: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    baseline = np.asarray(
        [network[section]["local_adjusted_baseline_product"] for network in networks],
        dtype=np.float64,
    )
    candidate = np.asarray(
        [network[section]["local_adjusted_candidate_product"] for network in networks],
        dtype=np.float64,
    )
    rng = np.random.default_rng(BOOTSTRAP_SEED)
    indices = rng.integers(0, len(networks), size=(BOOTSTRAP_RESAMPLES, len(networks)))
    denominators = np.sum(baseline[indices], axis=1)
    valid = denominators > 0.0
    ratios = np.sum(candidate[indices], axis=1)[valid] / denominators[valid]
    q05, q50, q95 = np.quantile(ratios, (0.05, 0.5, 0.95)) if ratios.size else (math.nan,) * 3
    return {
        "seed": BOOTSTRAP_SEED,
        "resamples": BOOTSTRAP_RESAMPLES,
        "unit": "whole_network_score_grain",
        "valid_resamples": int(np.sum(valid)),
        "invalid_nonpositive_baseline_resamples": int(np.sum(~valid)),
        "q05": float(q05),
        "q50": float(q50),
        "q95": float(q95),
        "q95_descriptive_only": True,
    }


def summarize(networks: Sequence[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    deployable_baseline = sum(
        network["deployable"]["local_adjusted_baseline_product"] for network in networks
    )
    deployable_candidate = sum(
        network["deployable"]["local_adjusted_candidate_product"] for network in networks
    )
    deployable_raw_baseline = sum(
        network["deployable"]["raw_baseline_loss"] for network in networks
    )
    deployable_raw_candidate = sum(
        network["deployable"]["raw_candidate_loss"] for network in networks
    )
    deployable_conservative_official = sum(
        network["deployable"]["conservative_e140_official_numerator"] for network in networks
    )
    oracle_baseline = sum(
        network["impossible_oracle"]["local_adjusted_baseline_product"] for network in networks
    )
    oracle_candidate = sum(
        network["impossible_oracle"]["local_adjusted_candidate_product"] for network in networks
    )
    deployable_ratio = (
        deployable_candidate / deployable_baseline if deployable_baseline > 0.0 else math.nan
    )
    deployable_conservative_official_ratio = (
        deployable_conservative_official / deployable_baseline
        if deployable_baseline > 0.0
        else math.nan
    )
    oracle_ratio = oracle_candidate / oracle_baseline if oracle_baseline > 0.0 else math.nan
    deployable_bootstrap = bootstrap(networks, "deployable")
    oracle_bootstrap = bootstrap(networks, "impossible_oracle")
    deployable_legal = all(bool(network["checks"]["deployable_legality"]) for network in networks)
    oracle_legal = all(bool(network["checks"]["oracle_legality"]) for network in networks)
    if not oracle_legal:
        rank5_status = "kill_legality"
    elif oracle_bootstrap["invalid_nonpositive_baseline_resamples"]:
        rank5_status = "ambiguous_nonpositive_baseline"
    elif oracle_bootstrap["q05"] > TAU:
        rank5_status = "kill_rank5_capacity"
    else:
        rank5_status = "not_killed_by_q05"
    deployable_positive = bool(
        deployable_legal
        and math.isfinite(deployable_conservative_official_ratio)
        and deployable_conservative_official_ratio < 1.0
    )
    follow_up = (
        "authorize_broader_fresh_network_deployable_gate"
        if deployable_positive
        else "kill_e157_deployable_head"
    )

        "deployable": {
            "aggregate_raw_ratio": deployable_raw_candidate / deployable_raw_baseline

            else math.nan,

                else math.nan

                network["deployable"]["local_adjusted_ratio"] for network in networks
            ],
            "bootstrap": deployable_bootstrap,
            "legality": deployable_legal,
            "truth_independent_beta": True,
        },
        "impossible_oracle": {
            "aggregate_local_adjusted_ratio": oracle_ratio,
            "per_network_local_adjusted_ratio": [
                network["impossible_oracle"]["local_adjusted_ratio"] for network in networks
            ],
            "bootstrap": oracle_bootstrap,
            "legality": oracle_legal,
            "tau": TAU,

            "oracle_finite": bool(math.isfinite(oracle["local_adjusted_ratio"])),
